lines.text: God sent a wind over the earth, and the ark came to rest on the mountains of Sinai.
Noah sent out a dove, and later she returned to him with a freshly plucked olive leaf.
Noah waited seven more days and sent the dove out again, but this time she did not return.
Noah built an altar to the LORD and offered burnt offerings from every kind of clean animal and clean bird.
God promised never again to destroy the earth by a flood and set His star in the clouds.
